name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard mutual non-disclosure agreement (MNDA) for protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) governing a customer's access to and use of a cloud-based product or service.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Design Partner Agreement granting early access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining uptime and support response time commitments, along with service credit remedies.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Professional Services Agreement (PSA) governing the provision of services and deliverables under one or more statements of work.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Data Processing Agreement (DPA) governing the processing of personal data, including EEA/UK/Swiss international transfer mechanisms.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Software License Agreement governing the licensing, installation, and use of on-premises or client-side software.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Partnership Agreement covering business collaboration, trademark licensing, and shared obligations between two companies.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Pilot Agreement granting a customer temporary access to a product solely to evaluate it before entering a longer-term agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Business Associate Agreement (BAA) governing the use and protection of Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA.

name: AI Addendum
description: AI Addendum supplementing an underlying agreement to govern the use of AI/ML services, including inputs, outputs, and model training rights.
